Karissa reported a fall at home on Sep 23, 2026 in the bathroom at night. Her son Marcus found her on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. No injury noted on assessment. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.
Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.

PT evaluation following fall on Sep 23, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.
Karissa enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.

Seen at partner hospital emergency department on Nov 5, 2026 for dehydration and dizziness; treated and released the same day. No new medications at discharge. Follow up with PACE primary care within 7 days.
Post-hospital follow-up for dehydration and dizziness. Karissa is back to baseline per her son. Reviewed discharge medications. Will monitor closely over the next two weeks.

Marcus reports Karissa has been more confused in the evenings for about two weeks, once leaving the stove on. Oriented to person and place today but not date. No fever. Plan: urinalysis, medication review, and PCP visit this week.
Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.
